text: {"lessons":["Selling winning positions one by one did not prevent later account losses; I should base each trade on a consistent portfolio plan, not on locking in gains.","A few quiet periods followed by a decline remind me that short-term account changes are uncertain; frequent checking or reacting to them is not a reliable strategy.","Before trading, I should set clear position and risk rules and follow them for both winners and losers, rather than letting regret or loss aversion decide."]}
